g.text: MLA at decode time: naive up-projection versus weight absorption
scores = q . K per head, over T tokens; softmax
out = softmax . V per head -> W_O
Regenerates 128 keys and 128 values for every cached token, every step.
The cache is small but the work to use it is the full MHA work.
scores = q_abs . C + q_R . k_R per head; softmax
o_lat = softmax . C per head (512 wide) -> W_UV folded into W_O
Attention runs over the latent as key and value: MQA with a 576-wide key and a
512-wide value shared by all heads. No key or value is ever materialized.
